title: CAM Assist Traceability Bundle Schema
description: Portable, reference-only artifact that aggregates a package's traceability sidecars (assumptions, risk, decision record, annotations, lineage) so the complete manufacturing review story can move between systems as one unit. A navigational index, NOT the source of truth: the referenced sidecars remain authoritative. The bundle references files, it does not own, copy, cache, or supersede their content. Informational only: it does not grant execution authority, constitute approval, enforce workflow, or authorize machine execution. References are strings; structural validation does not require the referenced files to exist (existence is a completeness finding, not a structural error).

record_version.description: Semantic version of the traceability bundle record FORMAT. Not a content-revision counter.

package_reference.description: Reference to the package whose traceability story this bundle aggregates. Accepts federated_package_id, relative path, or package directory name.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this bundle record was created

bundle_contents.description: Map of optional references to the package's traceability sidecars. Each value is a string path reference (resolved relative to the bundle's location). May be empty. References are navigational only; the referenced sidecars remain authoritative and are never owned, copied, or mutated by the bundle. Only the known slots below are permitted.

assumptions_file.description: Optional reference to a manufacturing assumptions sidecar.

risk_file.description: Optional reference to a risk assessment sidecar.

decision_record_file.description: Optional reference to a manufacturing decision record sidecar.

annotations_file.description: Optional reference to a review annotations sidecar.

lineage_file.description: Optional reference to a revision lineage sidecar.

authority.description: Informational authority constraints. When present, every flag MUST be true.

is_informational.description: MUST be true. This record is informational only.

does_not_authorize_execution.description: MUST be true. This record does not authorize machine execution.

does_not_bypass_human_review.description: MUST be true. This record does not bypass required human review.
